CustomField.formula: IF( Wait_Time__c != 0, IF( FLOOR(Wait_Time__c / 3600) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(Wait_Time__c / 3600)) + " Hour ", '' ) + IF( FLOOR(MOD(Wait_Time__c, 3600) / 60) > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Wait_Time__c, 3600) / 60)) + " Minutes ", '' ) + IF( ROUND(MOD(MOD(Wait_Time__c, 3600), 60), 0) > 0, TEXT(ROUND(MOD(MOD(Wait_Time__c, 3600), 60), 0)) + " Seconds", '' ), '' )
CustomField.label: Waiting Time
